reviews.text:
This is like a slightly more gentle version of the medicube pore pad zero 2.0. But the medicube I can only handle once a week max because it's a bit hard on me. This one I do twice a week and feel like I'm getting a great result.

I use it on my face, aempits, elbows, and knees so I'm not wasting anything. One pad does the whole thing it really goes a long way. Lots of product in the container so they're not dry at all. Great value and I will absolutely be buying these again.
reviews.zh:
呢款好似係 medicube pore pad zero 2.0 嘅溫和少少版本。不過 medicube 我最多只可以每星期用一次，因為對我嚟講有啲負擔。呢款我每星期可以用兩次，覺得效果好好。

我用喺面、腋下、手肘同膝頭，咁樣就唔會浪費。一塊化妝棉已經可以搞掂全部，好耐用。容器入面產品好多，所以化妝棉一啲都唔乾。好抵，我一定會再買。

reviews.text:
The Numbuzin No.4 Pore Zero Peeled Egg Toner Pad feels really smoothing and refreshing on the skin. It has that soft exfoliating effect that makes my skin feel instantly cleaner and more refined, especially around oily areas and visible pores.

After using it, my skin looked smoother, makeup applied better, and my pores appeared a bit more blurred. It does have a slightly sticky finish at first, but once it settles it feels fine. Overall, it’s great for oily skin if you want a quick “glass skin prep” step before makeup or skincare.
reviews.zh:
numbuzin No.4 Pore Zero Peeled Egg Toner Pad 用落皮膚感覺好順滑、清爽。佢有種柔和嘅去角質效果，令皮膚即時覺得更乾淨、更細緻，尤其係油性位同明顯毛孔嘅位置。

用完之後，皮膚睇落更滑，上妝更服貼，毛孔亦睇落稍微模糊咗少少。一開始會有少少黏嘅感覺，但等佢乾咗之後就冇問題。整體嚟講，如果你想喺化妝或者護膚之前快速做一個「玻璃肌準備」步驟，呢款對油性皮膚嚟講好好。

reviews.text: Been using these pads for a few weeks and my skin texture honestly feels way smoother. The pads have PHA + LHA, so they gently exfoliate without feeling too harsh, and I noticed my pores look cleaner around my nose area. One side is textured for exfoliating and the other side feels more hydrating. It does have fragrance/alcohol though, so I wouldn’t use it every single day if your skin is sensitive. But for oily/combo skin, it gives that smooth look!
reviews.zh: 用咗呢啲化妝棉幾個星期，皮膚質感真係順滑咗好多。化妝棉含 PHA + LHA，所以去角質好溫和，唔會太刺激，而且我見到鼻位嘅毛孔乾淨咗。一面有紋理、用嚟去角質；另一面就比較補濕。不過佢有香料／酒精，如果你皮膚敏感，就唔好每日都用。但對油性或混合性皮膚嚟講，會令皮膚睇落好滑！

reviews.text:
I’ve just added these toner pads to my routine, and I’m already impressed. The pads are well-soaked and have two different sides for gentle exfoliation and soothing.
Even after just a few uses, my skin feels much smoother—literally like a peeled egg! It’s very convenient to use in the morning to prep my skin for makeup. It doesn't feel harsh or drying at all. I’m looking forward to seeing how it helps my pores with longer use!
reviews.zh:
我啱啱加咗呢啲化妝棉入日常護理，已經覺得好正。化妝棉吸得夠飽，兩面各有唔同用途，一面溫和去角質，一面舒緩。
用咗幾次之後，皮膚已經順滑好多，真係好似剝咗殼嘅雞蛋（Peeled Egg）咁！朝早用嚟為化妝做準備都好方便。佢完全唔會覺得刺激或者乾燥。我期待長期用之後，佢對毛孔會有咩效果！

reviews.text: These might actually be my new favorite toner pads!! First of all, they make my skin look SO glowy and when I use them at night the shine lasts until the next morning without making my nose greasy or oily. I have combination skin and always struggle with controlling oil production on my nose and it’s so hard to find the right products to give me that glass skin effect without making my nose area look greasy. The formula is also GENIUS because the toner pads themselves absorb the perfect amount of toner, usually I wipe my face with toner pads and need to use 2 or 4 at a time to put them on different areas of my face and wait for the toner to absorb. However, with these my skin takes a little while to absorb the toner (doesn’t feel heavy at all though!!) so I can place the toner pads on different parts of my face at different times and the rest of my skin doesn’t get dry. LOVE, LOVE, LOVE
reviews.zh: 呢啲可能真係我新嘅最愛化妝棉！！首先，佢令我皮膚好有光澤，我晚上用，光澤可以維持到第二朝，而且唔會令鼻位油膩或者出油。我係混合性皮膚，一直好難控制鼻位出油，好難搵到可以令我有玻璃肌效果、又唔會令鼻位睇落油膩嘅產品。配方都係天才級，因為化妝棉本身吸收嘅化妝水份量啱啱好。通常我用化妝棉擦臉，要一次用兩至四塊，分開塗喺面嘅唔同位置，然後等化妝水吸收。但係呢款，皮膚要等一陣先吸收化妝水（而且完全唔會覺得重！），所以我可以喺唔同時間將化妝棉放喺面嘅唔同部位，其他位置都唔會乾。好鍾意、好鍾意、好鍾意

reviews.text: this toner pad does form a sticky layer on my skin, creating that illusion of ‘peeled egg’ skin. it’s ok at moisturising. not very cooling but ok for toner pad. the pad is thick and has a smooth side as well as a rough side. I leave these on for 15mins (like a mask) but these would be great for quick hydration by wiping across skin (but I would rather use regular toner like that rather than wasting these pads)
reviews.zh: 呢款化妝棉喺皮膚上會形成一層黏黏嘅膜，製造出「剝殼雞蛋」皮膚嘅錯覺。補濕方面都可以。涼感唔算好強，但作為化妝棉都ok。棉片幾厚，一面係滑嘅，一面係粗糙嘅。我會敷十五分鐘（似面膜咁），但如果只係快速擦喺皮膚上補濕，呢款都幾好（不過我寧願用普通化妝水咁擦，都唔想浪費呢啲化妝棉）。

reviews.text: been using them for a few weeks now I use them around 2 to 3 times a week and let’s just say they give that GLOW like that actual GLOWY GLASS SKIN. no joke it does it’s job. 1 pad is more than enough for face and neck and I still squeeze it to apply the essence excess on my face. so hydrating too. closes up my big pores real nice and exfoliates really well too. just get it! I’ll definetly purchase again
reviews.zh: 用咗幾個星期，我每星期用二至三次，可以話佢真係有 GLOW，真係好似真正嘅玻璃肌咁。唔係呃你，佢真係做到佢應該做嘅嘢。一塊化妝棉用嚟敷面同頸已經足夠，我仲會擠一擠，將多出嚟嘅精華塗喺面上。都好補濕。收細咗我嘅大毛孔，去角質效果都好好。快啲入手啦！我一定會再買

reviews.text: I love this brand and these toner pads are great for regular use. I don't want to use a chemical or physical exfoliate daily because my skin is quite sensitive but these work perfectly for every few days. They're gentle but effective, I can tell when I apply my serum after using these that my skin feels smoother and it's definitely brighter and more even overall. I saw results in my complexion after a few weeks so I'm really happy with these. I tend to use them for either a mask one day or exfoliating another day.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢個品牌，呢款化妝棉恆常使用都好好。我嘅皮膚比較敏感，唔想每日用化學或者物理去角質產品，但呢款每隔幾日用就啱啱好。佢溫和但有效，我用完之後再塗精華，都感覺到皮膚更順滑，整體肯定更亮、膚色更均勻。用咗幾個星期，膚色已經見到改善，所以我好滿意呢啲產品。我通常會有一日當面膜用，另一日用嚟去角質。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
